summary: Iteration 6 verified the 3 new credential-free features (A) Diagnosi Foto AI, (B) Piano di Lavoro (tank-mix workplan), (C) Fertilization edit (PUT). Backend: extended pytest suite from 36 to 42 tests, ALL 42 PASSING (100%) in ~80s. New tests: 3 for /api/diagnosis (real leaf-like JPEG b64, data-url prefix stripping, history w/ plant_name), 2 for /api/workplan (aggregates n_plants + computes liters=n*lpp and product_qty=dose_per_l*liters; rame+zolfo warning), 1 for PUT /api/fertilization/{id} (fields update + reminded reset). Frontend Playwright verified admin login -> Concimazioni add/edit (Modifica concimazione modal opens pre-filled, save persists), Piano di Lavoro page loads and workplan-refresh works, Diagnosi Foto AI: uploading a real base64 JPEG via diag-file and clicking diag-analyze-btn returned a 1317-char Italian markdown response with ALL 5 required sections (Diagnosi/Gravità/Sintomi/Trattamento/Prevenzione, including a dose-per-L table) and populated diag-history-row entries. Regression suite still 100% green.

issues: Dose value is not surfaced in the fert-row text (edit successfully persists via PUT, verified by backend test — UI just doesn't render dose in the row summary). Minor UX enhancement.
Still using native <input type='date'> instead of shadcn Calendar — carried over from iter5.

action_items: None blocking. All 3 new features work as specified end-to-end (backend + UI + AI integration).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/diagnosis: correctly strips 'data:image/...;base64,' prefix (verified). Uses emergentintegrations LlmChat + ImageContent with claude-sonnet-4-6 model. Returns italian markdown following exact spec. Persists to db.diagnoses with user_id, plant_id, notes, diagnosis, created_at.
GET /api/diagnosis: enriches with plant_name when plant_id present. _id stripped via clean(). ✅

GET /api/workplan: aggregates pending recs by product, computes liters=n_plants*lpp (from config liters_per_plant, default 10), product_qty=dose_per_l*liters. Emits rame+zolfo incompatibility warning and rame-fioritura/carenza warning. ✅
PUT /api/fertilization/{id}: updates all fields and resets reminded=False so reminder can re-fire on next cycle. ✅
Minor: workplan endpoint does not de-duplicate the 'Rame' warning — if only rame category present, still just 1 warning entry.
Minor: Diagnosis UI resizes to max 1024px JPEG q=0.85 which is fine, but very large source images (e.g. 12MP) could still exceed reasonable payload; consider max=800 for cellular users.

Minor: Diagnosis endpoint has no size/mime validation before sending to LLM — a bad base64 will just return 502 from claude. Consider adding basic base64 decode + PIL sanity check for better error messages.
